project.name: NeverFF
project.summary: Free independent site with League of Legends counter-build advisor, champion builds, counters, duo combos and tier lists from ~175,000 ranked EUW matches, plus World of Warcraft: Forever guides and an in-game leveling addon.
project.pricing: Free: "free, independent site"; no sign up. Free in-game leveling addon for WoW Forever.

about.text: Free independent site with League of Legends counter-build advisor, champion builds, counters, duo combos and tier lists from ~175,000 ranked EUW matches, plus World of Warcraft: Forever guides and an in-game leveling addon.
Site is shared with WoW Forever content; League section lives under /lol/ (counters, tiers, builds).

pricing.text: Free: "free, independent site"; no sign up. Free in-game leveling addon for WoW Forever.

updates.text: About page: pages are rebuilt from each new game update; pages say when something is projected instead of confirmed.

data_sources.text: League builds and win rates from about 175,000 ranked Solo/Duo matches on EU West, Platinum to Challenger, collected through Riot's official API; champion, item and rune names and art from Riot Data Dragon.

coverage.text: League: EU West ranked Solo/Duo Plat+ only (~175,000 matches); WoW Forever: 27 specs, dungeons, professions 1-300, leveling routes 1-60.
